sentence_quote: As far as the length of the sentence, I cannot say that twenty-one months imprisonment is manifestly excessive.
note: Fifteen months concurrent on bodily harm count; conviction appeal also dismissed.

sentence_quote: Taking into account the mitigating factors that we have mentioned above, the appropriate total sentence in this case would have been one of four years.
note: Seven years reduced to four by making count 3 concurrent; victim fine surcharge set aside.

sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the accused to an effective sentence of nine years on the charge of discharging a firearm at a person within intent to wound
note: Credit is double credit for 20 months pre-trial custody.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal to Mr. Sullivan to appeal his sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: Both sentenced to three years; only Sullivan appealed sentence.

sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of sexual assault and a related charge of sexual touching and sentenced to 1 year imprisonment and 2 years probation.
note: Mitigating factors referred to generally but not listed.

sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to the mandatory term of life imprisonment for the offence of second degree murder. He fixed the period of parole ineligibility at the statutory minimum of 10 years.
note: Conviction appeal and Crown appeal of parole ineligibility both dismissed.

note: 15 days concurrent for firearm; lifetime s. 109 prohibition; victim surcharge waived.

sentence_quote: to a 22-month custody-and-supervision order under para. 42(2)(n) of the YCJA.

offence_note: Two assaults on spouse by police officer
